purpose: W1.8 accessibility baseline -- injected into ScrapForAI's evaluate step against the five W1.7 golden browser scenarios. Vendored (not fetched at runtime) so the scan is deterministic and works offline.
upgradePolicy: Bump the version deliberately (download the new tarball's axe.min.js, update this file's version/shasum/integrity/fileSizeBytes) -- never silently replaced by a build step. Re-run the full five-routine scan after any bump and re-pin scripts/policy/a11y-baseline.json only if the new numbers are lower.
